name: Mita
description: The only girl in a village of boys and women, who learns all the village's children are children of the Rag Man.

description_citations.text: "Tapestries". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mita learns that all the village children are children of the Rag Man and flees, becoming the first woman to be changed.
timeline.quote: From then on, Mita can travel everywhere see the world in dreams

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "Inheritance , by S. D. Perry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kami pass over Mita and make villagers relive their tragedies, sapping their will to fight.
timeline.quote: As the kami passed over the village of Mita, the inhabitants relived their three most grievous tragedies.

citation.text: Three Tragedies (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A village whose inhabitants relived their tragedies.
